# SR's Consultancy

> SR's Consultancy is the independent web development practice of Smruti Ranjan Behera, based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India.

## What this website offers
- Custom web application development
- Management systems for businesses and institutions
- Business dashboards and database-driven applications
- Workflow and administrative process automation
- Modernization of existing websites and applications

## Technologies
Python, Django, PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, SQLite and Bootstrap.

## Example project areas
- Hostel management
- Human resource management and payroll
- Digital exam registration and admit card workflows
- College management
- Salon management
- Hospital management
- E-commerce marketplaces

Project descriptions are examples of software work and capabilities. Contact the developer to ask about a private demonstration and project scope.
